description: This file provides internal prefetching functions for the Abseil C++ library, including wrappers around compiler and hardware-specific prefetch instructions to optimize data cache usage.

methods.name: PrefetchT1
methods.description: Provides a prefetch instruction with moderate temporal locality, using compiler built-ins or hardware instructions depending on platform.

methods.name: PrefetchT2
methods.description: Provides a prefetch instruction with low temporal locality, using compiler built-ins or hardware instructions depending on platform.

methods.name: PrefetchNta
methods.description: Prefetches data with no temporal locality, using internal Abseil cache prefetching.

methods.name: PrefetchT0
methods.description: Prefetches data with high temporal locality, deprecated in favor of absl::PrefetchToLocalCache.
